title: It's Nice to Finally Meet You
original_title: It's Nice to Finally Meet You
overview: It's Nice to Finally Meet You follows Hannah, a woman who is feeling anxious about meeting the parents. She feels like a failure in every aspect of her life, but she desperately wants to be accepted by this new family. It takes every ounce of courage for her to get to the front door. When she finally does, a surprise is in store for everyone involved. This film is a story about resilience and the power of gifts.
